groups.note: Municipal, school, and special-district names are keyed from official Teton November general results in this archive. The Town of Jackson is the only incorporated municipality. Official Town of Jackson government pages and the FY2024 ACFR state that the mayor and four council members are elected at large; effective 2017 the mayor serves a four-year term. Official clerk generals put MAYOR contests on the November ballot (2012, 2014, 2016, 2020, 2024). Official 2026 Teton County School District #1 Trustee totals are from the official recount (DocumentCenter 42629). Official 2018 and official 2024 Teton clerk generals are official scans; those totals are from OCR of the official pages. Arne Olaus Jorgensen's official 2022 council term is ended at January 2025 when he takes office as mayor from the official 2024 clerk; no official appointment filling that council seat was found. Official 2016 conservation contests are titled only Teton Conservation District on the official clerk, without Urban/Rural/At-Large labels. Official mid-term vacancies are not invented.

groups.note: Supreme Court justices and the Chancery Court judge are the people in office this January, from official Wyoming Judicial Branch dates and official retention results (shared with other counties). Local rows are 9th Judicial District judges (Teton, Fremont, and Sublette). Official 2026 Teton clerk prints RETAIN JUDGE JAMES M. CONDER; the official 2026 SOS Teton precinct-by-precinct summary and the official Wyoming Judicial Branch Fremont 9th JD district page print Jason M. Conder, which is the name used here. Official 2024 clerk and official 2024 SOS print Katharine G. McKay; the official Sublette 9th JD district page prints Kate G. McKay for the same person. Where an official Teton clerk summary prints only a last name (official 2022 JUDGE ROBERTS / COOMBS; official 2020 CONDER / DENHARDT / HAWS / RADDA), the full name is taken from an official SOS line or official Wyoming Judicial Branch 9th JD page, and that source is cited. Judges of other districts are not copied here.
